signup_code.subject: Your sign-up code

signup_account_exists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email
signup_account_exists.text:
Someone tried to create a new account with this email, but you already have an account with it. To get in, open the app and sign in with this email; forgot your password? Reset it on the sign-in screen.

If it was not you, no action is needed.
signup_account_exists.text_pending:
Someone tried to create a new account with this email, but your account with this email is pending deletion. Changed your mind? Sign in to the app with this email and the deletion will be cancelled.

If it was not you and you still want to delete your account, no action is needed.

password_reset_code.subject: Your password reset code

email_change_code.subject: Confirm your new email

email_change_taken.subject: Attempt to link your email to another account
email_change_taken.text:
Someone tried to change the email of their account to this address, but it already belongs to your account. Your account has not changed.

If it was you, sign in to the account with this email.

mfa_failures.subject: Failed sign-in attempts
mfa_failures.text:
A wrong second-factor code was entered for your account {failures, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in a row. Someone may know your password, so change it.

When: {time}

account_deletion_scheduled.subject: Your account will be deleted
account_deletion_scheduled.text:
You requested to delete your account. It will be deleted permanently on {purge}.

Changed your mind? Just sign in to the app before then and the deletion will be cancelled.

account_restored.subject: Account deletion cancelled

account_deleted.subject: Your account was deleted
account_deleted.text: Your account was deleted: personal data was erased and it cannot be restored. Thank you for playing with us.

mfa_reset_scheduled.subject: Two-factor reset scheduled
mfa_reset_scheduled.text:
Following a support request, a reset of the two-factor protection of your account was scheduled. It will happen on {execute}: your authenticator app and recovery codes will stop working and all sessions will be signed out.

If you did not contact support, just sign in with your second factor and the reset will be cancelled.

mfa_reset_cancelled.subject: Two-factor reset cancelled
mfa_reset_cancelled.text:
The reset of the two-factor protection of your account was cancelled{by, select, owner { by you} system { automatically} other { by support}}. Two-factor protection stays on.

When: {time}
mfa_reset_cancelled.text_disabled:
The reset of the two-factor protection of your account was cancelled{by, select, owner { by you} system { automatically} other { by support}}.

When: {time}

mfa_reset_done.subject: Two-factor protection reset

captain_application_approved.subject: You are a captain in {city}
captain_application_approved.text:
{nickname}, your captain application in {city} has been approved. You can now build a team and create matches.

A probation period applies at first: your match reports start counting towards the city rankings after three played matches.

captain_application_rejected.subject: Captain application declined

captain_application_withdrawn_city.subject: Captain application withdrawn
captain_application_withdrawn_city.text:
{nickname}, you changed your city from {from_city} to {to_city}, so your captain application in {from_city} has been withdrawn.

To become a captain in your new city, apply again — no waiting needed.

captain_rejection.insufficient_info: Not enough information about the team and pitch

invite.subject: Admin panel invitation
invite.body:
Hello, {name}!

You have been invited to the admin panel. To sign in, open {link}, enter this email, the code {code} and choose a password. Then set up an authenticator app.

The code is valid until {expires}; case, dashes and spaces do not matter. Lost this email? You can have it sent again on the same page. If the code has expired, an admin panel administrator will send a new one (for the first owner, the server operator does).

If you did not expect this invitation, just ignore this email.

access_reset.subject: Admin panel access reset
access_reset.body:
Hello, {name}!

Your admin panel access has been reset: your password, second factor and recovery codes no longer work. To sign in again, open {link}, enter this email, the code {code} and choose a new password. Then set up an authenticator app again.

The code is valid until {expires}; case, dashes and spaces do not matter. Lost this email? You can have it sent again on the same page. If the code has expired, an admin panel administrator will send a new one (for the first owner, the server operator does).

If you did not expect this reset, tell an admin panel owner.

bootstrapped.subject: The server operator added owner {name}

locked.subject: Sign-in for {name} is locked for an hour

admin_disabled.subject: Admin account of {name} disabled

player_linked.subject: Your staff account is linked to a player account
player_linked.body:
Hello, {name}!

The admin owner {owner} linked your staff account to the player account {nickname}. You can no longer act on that account in the admin panel: applications, protection resets and other decisions about it will be made by another staff member.

If this is a mistake, contact the admin owner.

player_unlinked.subject: Player account link removed
player_unlinked.body:
Hello, {name}!

The admin owner {owner} removed the link between your staff account and the player account {nickname}.

If this is a mistake, contact the admin owner.
